question: Should `litellm-api-key` interactive onboarding grow its own proxy URL prompt and model-selection/discovery behavior, or should remote LiteLLM proxy users be routed to Custom Provider or a future dynamic catalog flow?
rationale: The code fix is not just plumbing: it changes provider-owned onboarding UX and may introduce credentialed endpoint probing policy, so automation should not choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the LiteLLM proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive flag path.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep the named LiteLLM choice as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts or docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model setup.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog
options.body: Leave the issue open until the broader credentialed provider catalog and live discovery policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the LiteLLM proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive flag path.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently owned the LiteLLM plugin setup boundary and carried forward the related non-interactive fix.
